Review remediation 1 switched directly on request->result without a local hoist; the generated 208-byte object and five-instruction mismatch set were identical, disproving the local-hoist hypothesis.

remediation_1_experiment.type_cleanup: Removed the unsupported RequestResult enum from fn_8017C810 and fn_8017C724; plain int and direct-member switch forms are codegen-neutral.
remediation_1_experiment.next_requirement: Keep next_target at 0x8017C8E0, but require a genuinely different register-allocation hypothesis before retrying or registering that function.
